analysis:
There are five unread emails, processed oldest first.
(1) Email 63: Cascade credit memo CM-38720 for $2,000.00. It references INV-38720, which totals $1,950.00. The credit exceeds the original invoice, so §8.1 Step 2 applies: DISP-HOLD, the prescribed clarification email to the vendor, and the note 'Placed on DISP-HOLD on 09/16/2025 — CM-38720.pdf'.
(2) Email 61: Pinnacle bank change request. The sender (bmatthews@pinnacleprintsvc.com) does not match the on-file email (bmatthews@pinnacleprint.com). Under §13.2 the agent posts BANK CHANGE REQUEST, then POTENTIAL BEC FRAUD, to #vendor-management. It must not reply, must not update records, and stops there.
(3) Email 64: Apex INV-2025-09745 against PO-2025-00123. The invoice number differs from earlier invoices, so it is not a duplicate. Invoice quantity 150 is less than GR quantity 300, so it is a partial invoice: log the match as Pass with the partial-invoice note, apply no hold, self-approve ($742.50), and post INVOICE APPROVED to #approvals.
(4) Email 65: Redwood RF-8125 against PO-2025-00124. Same treatment: quantity 5 is less than GR 10, partial invoice, $1,900.00.
(5) Email 62: SecureNet legal threat. SNC-2025-001 is on AUDIT hold. Do not pay, do not contact the vendor, do not modify records. Post LEGAL THREAT to #vendor-management.

findings.problem: The required DISP-HOLD note uses a hyphen instead of the prescribed em dash.
findings.fix: Use exactly: “Placed on DISP-HOLD on 09/16/2025 — CM-38720.pdf”.
findings.evidence: D1.0160 requires “Placed on DISP-HOLD on [MM/DD/YYYY] — [CM FILENAME]”; email 63 names the attachment “CM-38720.pdf” and the clock is 2025-09-16.

findings.problem: Calling the two invoices normal PO processing omits mandatory partial-invoice match-log notes and payment-approval confirmations.
findings.fix: Create the next Invoice Register and Match Log rows, apply no MATCH hold, use the exact D1.0135 partial-invoice note, self-approve, and post both exact INVOICE APPROVED messages to #approvals.
findings.evidence: D1.0088 requires every PO match attempt to be logged; D1.0135 requires the partial-invoice note; D1.0144 requires #approvals confirmation. Email 64 says “Quantity: 150” against PO-2025-00123 with “Qty Ordered 300” and “GR Qty 300”; email 65 says “Quantity: 5” against PO-2025-00124 with “Qty Ordered 10” and “GR Qty 10”.

findings.problem: The invariant expects the wrong bank name and does not protect the bank account number, so an unchanged correct row can fail while an account-number change can pass.
findings.fix: Expect Bank Name “Truliant Federal Credit Union”, Bank Routing Number “253175494”, and Bank Account Number “0082-1147-3355”; do not write the row.
findings.evidence: D1.0233 and D1.0236 prohibit updating vendor_master.xlsx or any records. The V-00003 row states “Truliant Federal Credit Union | 253175494 | 0082-1147-3355”, while O5 expects Bank Name “Truliant” and omits the account number.
